notes: The holdout was first read after the round-1 rules were frozen. Later rounds (benchmark conditions, hidden and weekly divergence, leader pullbacks) were chosen on train and validation only, but the holdout is no longer untouched, so the live record from the launch date is the only test that cannot have been fitted to the past. Benchmark confirmation was tested as a label and did not improve any engine.

exit_plan: Enter at the next session's open, not at the signal close, and skip it if it opens past T1 or below the stop.
Sell one third at T1, one third at T2, the last third at T3.
After T1, move the stop on the rest to your entry. After T2, move it to T1.
If a session gaps through the stop, you are out at the open, not at the stop price.
If nothing has resolved by the time limit, exit what is left at that day's close.
Size so that a stop-out costs an amount you can afford to lose repeatedly. The stop is the plan; the targets are the hope.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.tagline: Quality dips whose recovery has started
rebound.descended: the earlier Magic and MagicMagic screens
rebound.status_why: Its picks lagged randomly chosen stocks over the same dates, in both test periods, by a margin too big to be luck.

entry: Up to 45% and at least 15% below the 52-week high, and at least 10% above the 52-week low
Weekly RSI at 46 or more and rising over two weeks
Trigger: a close above the 20-day average and above the prior five-day high
rules.stop: The wider of the 50-day swing low less half an ATR, or three ATR below the price, kept between 4% and 12% below entry.
rules.targets: T1 is 40% of the way back to the 52-week high (never less than 1R), T2 is 70%, T3 is the high itself.

divergence.name: Divergence
divergence.tagline: Bullish RSI divergence, released by confirmation
divergence.status_why: Its picks did not beat randomly chosen stocks over the same dates in both test periods.

entry: Price makes a lower low while the 14-day RSI makes a higher low, the first low under RSI 45
Armed for six sessions after the second low is confirmed

Fires on a close above the prior day's high on a bullish candle, with at least two of: RSI rising two bars, MACD histogram turning up, volume 1.2x average, reclaim of the 10-day average, stochastic turning up from the low zone, hammer or engulfing
rules.stop: 0.3 ATR below the divergence low, never more than 10% below entry.
rules.targets: T1, T2 and T3 are the 38.2%, 61.8% and 100% retracements of the decline into the divergence low. The full retracement must pay at least 1.8R.

breakout.name: Breakout
breakout.tagline: Classic chart-pattern breakouts on a daily or weekly close
breakout.style: Positional on the daily chart, months on the weekly
breakout.status_why: Its picks beat random stocks in both test periods, but by too little, over too few independent months, to rule out luck.

entry: A pattern completes on a close: Darvas box, flat base, bull flag, cup and handle, inverse head and shoulders, double bottom, or a 55-day closing high out of a quiet range. A separate weekly rule fires on a close above the prior 26-week closing high.
The breakout candle is strong and bullish, on at least 2x average volume
Stage-2 trend (price above the 50-day, the 50 above the 200), within 15% of the 52-week high
In the top fifth of the market over six months, while the Nifty is above a rising 200-day average, and ahead of the index over three months
rules.stop: Below the pattern's own floor (box bottom, base low, flag low, handle low, shoulder, trough), less 0.3 ATR, never more than 10% below entry (15% on the weekly rule).
rules.targets: Measured moves: T1 is half the pattern height above the breakout level, T2 the full height, T3 one and a half times. The full move must pay at least 1.5R.

swing.name: Swing
swing.tagline: A pullback inside an uptrend, bought on the first confirmed turn
swing.status_why: Its picks beat random stocks in both test periods, but by too little, over too few independent months, to rule out luck.

entry: Uptrend: 50-day above 200-day, price above the 50-day and the 50-day rising
A pullback that tagged the 20-day average with RSI cooling below 50 but not below 28
Trigger: a bullish close above the prior high, back above the 20-day average, RSI turning up between 42 and 65, ADX 16 or more
Ahead of the index over three months, in the top 15% of the market over six, with the Nifty above a rising 200-day
rules.stop: Below the lowest low of the pullback less 0.2 ATR, never more than 7% below entry.
rules.targets: T1 at 1.2R, T2 at 2R or the 20-day high if higher, T3 at 3R.
